nodes.title: 2026-10-10 11:30 UTC narrow safety release 7ec8202 (patch 03 as amended) live on taxila.dev as revision taxila-web--s7ec8202-cdah, via scripts/deploy-azure.mjs --gate from the main tree on the base branch. Gate on the exact commit: tsc, vite, npm test 2,591 pass / 0 fail / 3 skipped (2,594), prompt budget worst 1,645 / 2,600; every migration applied on the target database; canary w0-smoke 4/4 at 0% traffic; then 100%. tests/prod/w2i-safety.mjs on https://taxila.dev: 1/1 (the disclosure arm is skipped on a remote target by design, since it opens a real safeguarding incident; the predicate's disclosure behaviour is covered offline by ms-r4-safety03-review-numbers).
